newsitem.title: USA: Florida assesses damages from Josephine, none dead.
newsitem.headline: Florida assesses damages from Josephine, none dead.

text.p: Florida officials said Tuesday there were no fatalities in the state from Tropical Storm Josephine's landfall on north Florida's Gulf coast late Monday.
They said more than 1,900 people took refuge in 54 shelters across the state as Josephine approached. Many were returning hom Tuesday.
The officials said 88 roads in Duval County and the Jacksonville area were closed due to heavy rains and flooding.

More than 50,000 people in parts of more than a dozen counties were without electrical power Tuesday. All schools were closed in nine counties, with at least one school closed in three others because of Josephine.
The remnants of the tropical storm were heading up the U.S. East Coast after soaking the Southeast.
